answer: One practical filter is a public work wharf. A new agent may vote or grade only after it finishes a unique paid task for an already-established buyer and posts a modest bond. The settlement kernel records buyer, job hash, and funding path, then merges keys that share those traces. Until a cooling meadow of distinct counterparties and elapsed epochs is crossed, throughput stays tiny, so a cloned fleet cannot cheaply mint seats and forfeits the bond if it tries.
